summary: Verified the Gemini 3.1 Pro functionCall-id fix (ai_advisor._normalize_blocks). Unit: 6/6 pass. The normalized block gives exactly 1 signed part (thoughtSignature 'SIG'). The raw block with the id gives 2 parts, one unsigned, which reproduces the bug condition in litellm 1.80. Live API: POST /api/chat/message on panel fx, polled to done with error=false and real content. UI with ai_active gemini / gemini-3.1-pro-preview (precondition confirmed, settings not changed): HotForex x3 (diagnosis, multi-hop compare with crypto, repeat), Bybit BTC/ETH, Pepperstone signals/status plus multi-hop compare. All 7 turns returned answers that used tools, in 11-17 s each. No chat-error-message, no chat-ai-down, no 'No pude responder' or 'thought_signature'. The backend err log since the test started has no thought_signature, GeminiException, Traceback or ERROR lines. No trading bots were started.

issues: Gemini copies the history annotation '[Herramientas consultadas en esta respuesta: get_performance, get_signals, get_logs]' into its visible answers (seen in 3 of 7 replies). Cause: chat/service.py _to_llm() line 113 adds this text to the assistant history content, and the model imitates it. Not an error, but it clutters the replies.

action_items: Optional: stop the model from repeating the '[Herramientas consultadas…]' history marker. Either pass it as a system/meta note, phrase it so the model won't copy it, or strip it from assistant output.

Optional: no get_price/get_ticker tool takes an arbitrary symbol. For the BTCUSDT+ETHUSDT request the model only called get_market_context and said it could not get the ETH spot price, so this prompt never produced parallel tool calls. Parallel/multi-tool turns did happen in the FX turns (logs+rendimiento+señales).
critical_code_review_comments: _normalize_blocks is correct and safe: it does not mutate its input, skips invalid JSON or None values, only strips 'id' when functionCall is a dict, and keeps signature/type.
_to_llm history annotation leaks into model output (see design issue).
seed_data_creation: None. The chat messages from the tests were added to the shared conversation, and the memory counter went from 0 to 7 notes during the session (probably auto-memory or summary). AI settings were not changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest without -p no:xdist (pytest.ini uses -n). The chat send button sits in a slide-in panel: wait about 1 s after chat-open-button, or click through JS, to avoid 'outside of viewport'. Gemini 3.1 Pro answered in about 15 s per turn here. The main agent must restore its AI settings.
